title: Axolotl eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="26" ry="20" fill="#f7a8c4"/>
  <!-- Belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="18" ry="13" fill="#ffc9dc"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M24 72 Q10 70 8 60 Q14 64 20 64 Q16 56 24 58 Q22 66 30 68 Z" fill="#f28bb3"/>
  <!-- Left gill stalks -->
  <path d="M30 42 Q20 34 16 26" stroke="#e86a9a" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M28 46 Q16 42 10 38" stroke="#e86a9a" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M30 50 Q20 52 12 54" stroke="#e86a9a" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Left gill frills -->
  <circle cx="15" cy="25" r="4" fill="#ff8fb8"/>
  <circle cx="9" cy="37" r="3.5" fill="#ff8fb8"/>
  <circle cx="11" cy="55" r="3.5" fill="#ff8fb8"/>
  <!-- Right gill stalks -->
  <path d="M70 42 Q80 34 84 26" stroke="#e86a9a" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M72 46 Q84 42 90 38" stroke="#e86a9a" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M70 50 Q80 52 88 54" stroke="#e86a9a" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Right gill frills -->
  <circle cx="85" cy="25" r="4" fill="#ff8fb8"/>
  <circle cx="91" cy="37" r="3.5" fill="#ff8fb8"/>
  <circle cx="89" cy="55" r="3.5" fill="#ff8fb8"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="45" rx="24" ry="18" fill="#f7a8c4"/>
  <!-- Face lighter patch -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="16" ry="12" fill="#ffc9dc"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="43" r="4" fill="#5a2a4a"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="43" r="4" fill="#5a2a4a"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="42" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="42" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Smiling mouth -->
  <path d="M44 52 Q50 58 56 52" stroke="#d1567f" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Snack: cookie in front -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="7" fill="#d9a05b"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#b87d3a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Cookie chips -->
  <circle cx="47" cy="55" r="1.2" fill="#6b3a1f"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="56" r="1.2" fill="#6b3a1f"/>
  <circle cx="49" cy="61" r="1.2" fill="#6b3a1f"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="60" r="1.2" fill="#6b3a1f"/>
  <!-- Little arms holding cookie -->
  <path d="M34 60 Q40 56 44 57" stroke="#f28bb3" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M66 60 Q60 56 56 57" stroke="#f28bb3" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cute blush -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="50" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#ff9ec4" opacity="0.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="50" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#ff9ec4" opacity="0.8"/>
</svg>
